reason: Both choose do with mistake to describe committing an error. Reporting another person's error and admitting one's own use the same mistake verb-noun combination. Regret is a related communicative setting but a different production dimension.
pattern_description: The observed do a mistake formulations recur when describing errors by different people. This supports a specific mistake collocation pattern rather than a general problem with expressing regret or all verb-noun combinations.
